scope: Observed single calls from attended segments 04 and 05; not a latency benchmark or representative distribution.
interpretation: The calls returned in roughly 0.1 to 0.5 seconds in these observations. Generating the call and assignment text took longer. This does not measure recipient scheduling, understanding or useful response time. Product-fact pagination is file/tool input retrieval, not direct inter-agent message transport. Existing bounded-read tooling was already present; improving it would require reducing unnecessary exchanges or packing input more efficiently within the applicable output limits.
